## What's Changed
* "above" -> "below" by @ismailarilik in https://github.com/docker/docker-bench-security/pull/540
* handle "null" values and missing jq by @halfluke in https://github.com/docker/docker-bench-security/pull/541
* feat: use SHA instead of tags for base image by @UlisesGascon in https://github.com/docker/docker-bench-security/pull/543
* update check ID and add check groups for CIS Controls v8 by @martipoe in https://github.com/docker/docker-bench-security/pull/546

## New Contributors
